model_settings.initial_labels: 1934 nonconflicting rule candidates; no LLM/human Test labels

tfidf.fit_corpus: 3038 eligible non-test texts; fixed unsupervised vocabulary including pool

minilm.chunking: tokenizer non-overlapping max_seq_length-2 content tokens; normalized token-weighted mean of normalized chunk embeddings; no discarded tokens

model_settings.diversity: 5*batch most uncertain, first most uncertain then farthest-first cosine
model_settings.test_unclear: exclude only from five-label metric denominator; retain all60 predictions and report reference coverage
model_settings.pool_unclear: review counts toward budget; remove any weak target for selected UNCLEAR record, no all-negative fabricated label
model_settings.intervals: test NCT bootstrap 1000 replicates percentile95% at seed20261123; seed mean/min/max/SD descriptive, not CI
model_settings.llm_fusion: not run: only30 conservative consensus candidate records and no OtherDomain positive; no superiority claim

deletion_conditions.DELETE_CLASSIFIER: frozen historical feature matrices, remove classifier rows
deletion_conditions.DELETE_REFIT_TFIDF: TF-IDF diagnostic only; also remove 10 texts from vectorizer corpus

primary: five fixed training folds against weak targets; all conditions reported; no selection
secondary: post hoc reuse of 58 decidable Test_60 rows; 2000 paired NCT bootstrap draws
